description: Defects the simulator can inject and the outcome the ingest engine must produce for each. Errors are rejected with the listed ACK code and dead-lettered. Warnings are accepted with AA and attached to the hl7.validated payload.

faults.name: truncated_message
faults.description: The message is cut after the MSH segment and half of the next segment, so required segments are missing.

faults.name: wrong_encoding_characters
faults.description: MSH-2 repeats the component separator, so the encoding characters are not distinct.

faults.name: lf_segment_terminators
faults.description: Segments end with LF instead of CR.

faults.name: non_numeric_nm
faults.description: An OBX with value type NM carries a non-numeric OBX-5.

faults.name: invalid_timestamp
faults.description: MSH-7 holds a date that does not exist (month 13).

faults.name: duplicate_control_id
faults.description: A message with different content reuses the MSH-10 of the previous message.

faults.name: trailing_separators
faults.description: Extra field separators are appended to the end of every segment.

faults.name: non_ascii_bytes
faults.description: The patient family name contains UTF-8 bytes outside ASCII while MSH-18 declares no character set.

faults.name: oversized_frame
faults.description: The MLLP frame is padded past the configured maximum frame size with an NTE segment.

error_codes.MSH_MISSING: The message does not start with an MSH segment.
error_codes.ENCODING_CHARACTERS_INVALID: MSH-1 or MSH-2 does not define distinct encoding characters.
error_codes.SEGMENT_ID_INVALID: A segment identifier is not three upper-case letters or digits.
error_codes.ESCAPE_SEQUENCE_INVALID: An escape sequence is unterminated or unknown.
error_codes.FRAME_OVERSIZE: The MLLP frame exceeds the configured maximum size.
error_codes.MESSAGE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: MSH-9 is not ADT^A01, ADT^A03 or ORU^R01.
error_codes.REQUIRED_SEGMENT_MISSING: A segment required for the message type is absent.
error_codes.CONTROL_ID_DUPLICATE: MSH-10 was already used by a message with different content.
error_codes.TIMESTAMP_INVALID: A DTM field required by the pipeline cannot be parsed.
error_codes.VALUE_TYPE_MISMATCH: OBX-5 does not match the value type in OBX-2.
error_codes.RESULT_STATUS_INVALID: OBX-11 is empty or not a known result status.
error_codes.PATIENT_IDENTIFIER_MISSING: PID-3 carries no identifier, so the message has no MRN to key on.
error_codes.FIELD_VALUE_INVALID: A field required by the pipeline cannot be read as its HL7 data type.

warning_codes.SEGMENT_TERMINATOR_NOT_CR: Segments are terminated with LF or CRLF instead of CR.
warning_codes.TRAILING_SEPARATOR: A segment ends with one or more empty trailing fields.
warning_codes.NON_ASCII_BYTES: The message contains bytes outside 7-bit ASCII.
warning_codes.OBSERVATION_CODE_UNKNOWN: OBX-3 is not in the LOINC table.
warning_codes.VALUE_IMPLAUSIBLE: A numeric OBX-5 is outside the plausible physiologic range for its code.
